viewerQuestion: Will a new GPU make every game faster by the same amount?
viewerTakeaway: The same GPU upgrade can add a lot in one game and much less in another, so I check the games I play, not one average.

requiredCapabilities.description: Existing deterministic static Compare UI capture.

beats.narration: Same CPU, new GPU. Which game gets the bigger boost?
beats.onScreenText: Same CPU. New GPU. Which game gains more?

beats.narration: Alan Wake 2, or Valorant? Pick one now.
In SpecSmith's model estimates, going from an RTX 4060 to an RTX 5070, with the same Ryzen 5 7600 at 1440p High, takes Alan Wake 2 from 43 to 65 FPS.
The same upgrade takes Valorant from 263 to 305 FPS.
SpecSmith's model weights each game by how much it leans on the GPU, and it gives Alan Wake 2 far more GPU weight than Valorant.
beats.onScreenText: Same upgrade. Different games, different gains.

beats.narration: So check the games you actually play before you upgrade.
